profile.headline: Frontend developer
profile.summary:
Web developer with experience in multiple roles, including:  Project Mangement, Technical Writing, and QA, seeking a position in Web Development.

Specialties: Experience in multiple roles in the product development cycle 
Experience working independently and in small teams of 3-4 people.
Quick Learner able to adapt to multiple roles and multi task

positions.title: Senior Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
• Use of AI to improve productivity, while maintaining quality code.  Also used to assist in debugging and fixing issues and helping to understand code I’m not familiar with.
• Create components and rebuilt features on mobile dating site using React, Tailwind, MobX, Perl, Mysql.
• Heavy use of AI to build new website from scratch.  Gave direction to AI to ensure the new site code quality is maintained.  Code was clean enough to allow us to quickly fix simple issues manually, while saving more complex and time consuming tasks forAI.
• Responsible for implementing new stories, writing unit tests, and peer reviewing code.
• Full stack development of customer and internal facing features using Perl, Angular, Material, Javascript, JSON, • Perl, NodeJS, and Mysql.  Have some experience with Python, but mostly with AI’s help.
• Manage release for newly implemented features to Kubernetes and bare metal servers
• Fixed site vulnerabilities as part of a security initiative.
• Investigate and fix high priority / feature down issues.
• Train new employees

positions.title: Tools/Web Developer Lead
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed internal tools and websites using perl, mysql, html, css and javascript
•	Troubleshoot and fixed issues reported with existing tools and websites
•	Managed small team comprised of developers and QA.
•	Looked to improve skills of QA by assigning simple programming bugs and training

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed multiple projects in a fast paced work environment (5-6 projects with 1 month release cycle)
•	Met with stakeholders to define project requirements
•	Managed small project teams to complete projects according to stakeholders specifications
•	Trained new hires on internal tools
•	Documented new features (describe new features, how to use new features) for customer service training.

positions.title: QE/QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	QA existing and new site features
•	Grey box testing (ran scripts, checked data against database)
•	Wrote test cases to test product according to specification
•	Reported bugs and made suggestions for improvement
•	Experience using bugzilla and jira
•	Sought to improve the quality of the product by assuming the role of the user and using the product
•	Made suggestions for improvements
